frequency_question: How often does an oversight body issue a final revocation of an accrediting agency's recognition status during a renewal review window?
membership_rule: Includes all formal federal or central reviews of national professional accrediting bodies (such as in education, medicine, law, or engineering) over the past 50 years where recognition status was up for renewal or under formal compliance review. Excludes voluntary relinquishments.
window: Within the standard 12-to-18 month administrative review window leading up to a fixed expiration date.

cases.name: ABA Accreditation Review 1990s (Department of Education compliance proceedings)

coverage_note: 6 named; covers primary federal agency recognition reviews for major national accreditors over recent decades.
known_gaps: Excludes minor advisory warnings that fell short of formal revocation proceedings.
skeleton: 6 named administrative review cycles of major institutional/professional accreditors under federal scrutiny.
multiplier: 6 observed cases representing distinct major review cycles for primary professional/educational accreditors.
validity_reason: Administrative review standards and regulatory frameworks for accrediting agencies change slowly over multi-year legislative and regulatory cycles.
